```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown

from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD CMS CONTENT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

with open("../../content/ecocast_explorer.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def md(value):
    return markdown.markdown(
        str(value or ""),
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )

hero = data.get("hero", {})
instructions = data.get("instructions", {})
application = data.get("application", {})
disclaimer = data.get("disclaimer", {})

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# INSTRUCTION STEPS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

instruction_steps = ""

for step in instructions.get("steps", []):

    instruction_steps += f"""
    <li class="cw-ecocast-explorer-step">
      <span>{safe(step.get('text'))}</span>
    """

    if step.get("details"):

        instruction_steps += """
        <ul class="cw-ecocast-explorer-substeps">
        """

        for detail in step.get("details", []):
            instruction_steps += f"""
            <li>{safe(detail)}</li>
            """

        instruction_steps += "</ul>"

    instruction_steps += "</li>"

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# APPLICATION SETTINGS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

app_url = safe(application.get("url"))

try:
    app_height = max(
        400,
        min(1600, int(application.get("height", 850)))
    )
except (ValueError, TypeError):
    app_height = 850

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-ecocast cw-ecocast-explorer-page">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-ecocast-topbar">

    <a class="cw-ecocast-brand" href="ecocast.html">
      <img src="images/ecocast_logo_003366.png"
           alt="EcoCast logo">
    </a>

    <nav class="cw-ecocast-tabs"
         aria-label="EcoCast navigation">

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab"
         href="about_ecocast.html">
        About EcoCast
      </a>

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab"
         href="ecocast_map.html">
        EcoCast Map
      </a>

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab is-active"
         href="ecocast_explorer.html"
         aria-current="page">
        EcoCast Explorer
      </a>

    </nav>

  </div>

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-explorer-hero">

    <span class="cw-ecocast-explorer-eyebrow">
      {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

    <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

  </section>

  <!-- INFORMATION & INSTRUCTIONS -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-explorer-instructions">

    <details class="cw-ecocast-explorer-details">

      <summary>

        <div class="cw-ecocast-explorer-summary-text">

          <span class="cw-ecocast-explorer-section-label">
            {safe(instructions.get('eyebrow'))}
          </span>

          <h2>{safe(instructions.get('title'))}</h2>

        </div>

        <span class="cw-ecocast-explorer-expand-icon"
              aria-hidden="true">+</span>

      </summary>

      <div class="cw-ecocast-explorer-instructions-body">

        <div class="cw-ecocast-explorer-intro">
          {md(instructions.get('introduction'))}
        </div>

        <ol class="cw-ecocast-explorer-steps">
          {instruction_steps}
        </ol>

      </div>

    </details>

  </section>

  <!-- INTERACTIVE APPLICATION -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-explorer-application">

    <div class="cw-ecocast-explorer-app-heading">

      <div class="cw-ecocast-explorer-app-heading-text">

        <span class="cw-ecocast-explorer-section-label">
          {safe(application.get('eyebrow'))}
        </span>

        <h2>{safe(application.get('title'))}</h2>

        <p>{safe(application.get('description'))}</p>

      </div>

      <a class="cw-ecocast-explorer-open-btn"
         href="{app_url}"
         target="_blank"
         rel="noopener noreferrer">

        {safe(application.get('button_label'))}
        <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>

      </a>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-ecocast-explorer-app-frame">

      <iframe
        src="{app_url}"
        title="EcoCast Explorer Interactive Application"
        width="100%"
        height="{app_height}"
        loading="lazy"
        allowfullscreen>
      </iframe>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-ecocast-explorer-app-footer">

      <p>{safe(application.get('fallback_text'))}</p>

      <a href="{app_url}"
         target="_blank"
         rel="noopener noreferrer">
        {safe(application.get('button_label'))}
        <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
      </a>

    </div>

  </section>

  <!-- DISCLAIMER -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-disclaimer
                  cw-ecocast-explorer-disclaimer">

    {md(disclaimer.get('text'))}

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
